//: TEST ONLY. Redirects the std http server to serveShim.ts so importing an
edge function hands over its handler instead of binding a port.
Passed explicitly with `deno test --import-map=...`, and deliberately NOT
placed in a root deno.json: the `edge` CI job runs `deno check` over the
real sources, and if this map applied there it would typecheck the shim
instead of the real std module — quietly removing the coverage that job
Both std versions in use are listed. `grep -h http/server.ts` across
a version that is added without being listed here will bind a real port
and hang the test, which is a loud enough failure to notice.
web-push is redirected for a different reason: it sends over node:https
rather than fetch, so the harness's routing fetch cannot see it and a send
in a test resolves DNS for real. The shim records sends instead, which is
what makes the retire-on-410 path testable at all.
